meanings.meaning: Stubborn and unwilling to obey God. Stiff-necked people keep rebelling against Him and will not accept His commands, like an animal that refuses the yoke.

problems.problem: Meaning 1 is still too narrow for Proverbs 29:1 because it focuses on obeying God and accepting His commands.
No meaning covers remaining stubborn despite repeated correction, as in Proverbs 29:1.
